prompt:
You help a computer-use agent navigate a web page. Return JSON only.
Start URL: https://duckduckgo.com/?q=linux
Goal: DuckDuckGo에서 linux를 검색해줘

Predict short tokens (1-4 words each) that will appear on screen:
- ready_any: tokens that signal the page has loaded
- success_any: tokens that signal the goal is achieved (empty = same as ready_any)
- forbid_any: tokens that signal a wrong page or failure
- pick_query: the best search phrase to find the click target
- pick_required: true if the user must click something
- dismiss_any: tokens for consent/close/overlay buttons
- blocked_any: tokens for anti-bot/blocked/captcha pages
- ignore_any: tokens to skip when picking

Return JSON: {"ready_any":[],"success_any":[],"forbid_any":[],"pick_query":"","pick_required":true,"dismiss_any":[],"blocked_any":[],"ignore_any":[]}
